node.statement: By def-extended-delta-inclusion, the defining homomorphism-error and two-sided norm inequalities only weaken when their nonnegative tolerance is increased. Hence an extended d_R-inclusion with d_R <= W.c0_cb*epsilon is an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon-inclusion; together with the preceding unit estimate, this is the required conclusion for the arbitrary A and epsilon.
